notes.4.10.5.1: 'scir.ent' and 'valgus' are read as scirent and vulgus.

nodes.text: But they, who knew well enough that the cycles of time fulfil their appointed changes, and that the moon is eclipsed when it either passes beneath the earth or is overpowered by the sun, do not teach the common people the reason as they themselves understood it:
